title: Marilyn Horne Museum and Exhibit Center

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Marilyn Horne Museum and Exhibit Center showcases highlights from the personal archive of legendary opera singer Marilyn Horne. Located in Bradford, Pennsylvania’s historic downtown district, the museum is housed in a six-story, circa 1932 Art Deco building. Collection highlights include costumes, interactive audio and visual exhibits, and a documentary film shown in a sumptuous theater designed to evoke the ambience of Venice’s famed Teatro la Fenice. The museum has a variety of unique experiences offered throughout the year. These include: high tea, a luxury Venetian dessert buffet, a Venetian mask making activity, private lectures, and more.
